subject: Art.28/30 evidence handoff — sampling exception and escrow access
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@tidalbank.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Privacy Team <privacy@tidalbank.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:14:00 +0100
Subject: Evidence handoff for Art.28/30 — sampling clarification

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of our GDPR onboarding checklist we need: a copy of the Article 30 processing ledger extract (for the onboarding window), the subprocessor roster + contract dates, and a representative sampling of access/audit logs.

Two clarifications from our side:
- We usually accept a 10% sampling of access logs for initial intake, but for accounts that process high-value financial PII we need an exception to 10% — typically 25% or targeted sampling around high-sensitivity flows.
- If there are operational blockers to producing raw logs (e.g. retention constraints, KV cache redaction), we will consider an escrowed ledger extract or an auditor-led read-only session as an alternative.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) produce Art.28/30 ledger export for Mar 2027–Apr 2027 window;
2) supply a 25% sampled set for the access logs OR provide an escrow/read-only alternative;
3) list any subprocessors involved in tokenization or model hosting with contract dates.

We aim to close intake by Apr 20. Appreciate a proposed delivery plan.

Best,
Liam
Head of Privacy Operations
Tidal Bank

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@tidalbank.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Evidence handoff for Art.28/30 — sampling clarification

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: yes, we can produce the ledger extract; yes, we can support a higher sampling rate for sensitive accounts; and we will provide the subprocessor roster with contract start/end dates.

Proposed plan (high level):
- By Apr 14: deliver Art.30 ledger extract (PDF) + evidence index CSV (redacted where required) — attached.
- By Apr 16: provide 25% sampled access logs covering high-sensitivity endpoints (filtered & redacted) OR set up an auditor read-only session if raw export is constrained.
- Apr 17–19: synchronized review call and optional live walkthrough for your audit team.

Attachments: redwood_art30-ledger-extract-20270412.pdf (ledger extract), evidence-index-brief.csv (index). I have looped in Ben (sales engineering) and Kim (privacy ops) to confirm logistics and any escrow steps.

Is the high-level schedule acceptable? If so I will circulate a short statement of attestation and an escrow access proposal for your legal team.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Privacy & Risk
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Evidence handoff for Art.28/30 — sampling clarification

Team — forwarding Liam's ask. Key asks: 25% sampling for access logs OR escrow/read-only alternative; ledger extract for Mar–Apr; subprocessor roster with contract dates. Tight timeline: Tidal wants intake closed by Apr 20.

Ben — can the SRE/SE team produce a 25% sampled export that redacts KV caches and user-generated content by Apr 16? If not, propose escrow read-only flow.

Kim — please confirm whether we can include contract start/end dates for the subs (especially for tokenization & hosting partners) and flag any with export/retention constraints.

Priyom / Tessa — if escrow access is needed, I'm proposing a temporary auditor read-only session (Doc-level access + timeboxed AWS role). I attached a brief escrow-access-proposal.txt draft — comments?

Thanks — Marissa

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evidence handoff for Art.28/30 — sampling clarification

Marissa / Kim — quick update from engineering:
- We can export a 25% sample of access events filtered to high-sensitivity endpoints (auth, file retrieval, KV access) by Apr 16. The export pipeline will sanitize token values and strip full user text where required. Format: CSV (timestamp, actor_id_hash, endpoint, action, service_node, retention_bucket).
- If Tidal requires raw audit logs (full payload) we will need an auditor-led session; we cannot provide raw payloads outside an escrowed, monitored environment due to retention & PII policies.
- ETA for the ledger extract: end-of-day Apr 14 (PDF + CSV index).

I will attach the sample schema and a checklist for the auditor session.

Ben
Lead Sales Engineer

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@tidalbank.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, Privacy Team <privacy@tidalbank.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 16:42:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Evidence handoff for Art.28/30 — sampling clarification

Hi Liam — quick confirmation following internal checks:

1) Art.30 ledger extract (Mar 1–Apr 11, 2027) is attached (redwood_art30-ledger-extract-20270412.pdf) along with an evidence index (evidence-index-brief.csv).

2) Engineering will provide a 25% sampled set of access events for the high-sensitivity endpoints by Apr 16. Attached is the sample schema. If your legal/audit team prefers an auditor-led read-only session instead of a raw export, we are happy to schedule one; we will provision a timeboxed IAM role and session recording.

3) Subprocessor roster with contract start/end dates: see excerpt below (full roster attached in the drive link).
- TokenizeCo — model tokenization — contract: 2025-06-01 to 2028-05-31
- HostEdge — model hosting (EU region) — contract: 2024-11-15 to 2028-11-14
- KeySafe KMS — key management — contract: 2026-01-01 to 2029-12-31

Next steps: please confirm whether you want the sampled CSV export delivered to your secure SFTP or whether you prefer the read-only escrow session. If SFTP, confirm a PGP key for delivery; if read-only, propose dates for Apr 19–20.

Attaching: redwood_art30-ledger-extract-20270412.pdf (ledger extract); evidence-index-brief.csv (index); escrow-access-proposal.txt (proposal). Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-art30-evidence

Thanks — Marissa
Senior Manager, Privacy & Risk
Redwood Inference
